name: Student Residence Card (Carte d'Immatriculation -- Études)

qualifying_event.description: For foreign nationals enrolled at a Moroccan educational institution, holding a long-stay visa marked for study purposes where required by nationality.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Enrollment certificate from a Moroccan institution; long-stay study visa where required; proof of means of subsistence.

requirements.blocker_text: Enrollment at a Moroccan educational institution is required, evidenced by an admission/enrollment certificate.
Sufficient means of existence appropriate to student status must be demonstrated, per the general 'carte d'immatriculation' requirements under Law 02-03.

evidence_required.document: Enrollment certificate from a Moroccan institution

outcome.duration_length: 1 year initially, renewable (general carte d'immatriculation progression: 1yr, then 2-3yr, 5yr, 10yr on successive renewals)
outcome.physical_presence_requirement: card lapses after 6 months' continuous absence from Morocco

sources.title: GADEM (Groupe Antiraciste d'Accompagnement et de Défense des Etrangers et Migrants) legal guide -- Carte d'immatriculation categories under Law 02-03: student card among 5 categories, 1-10 year validity range, 6-month absence lapse rule, sufficient-means requirement
Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Morocco), Embassy in Washington -- confirms long-stay visa categories exist but does not itemize student-specific figures on the page fetched

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Morocco). STATUS: DRAFT -- Morocco's own government portals (diplomatie.ma, service-public.ma) did not surface a dedicated, detailed student-visa requirements page in this pass; the category's existence and general structure come from GADEM's Law 02-03 legal guide (a respected Moroccan migrants'-rights NGO, tier-3 here since it summarizes rather than quotes the primary text verbatim).
